first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, so simplifying onboarding directly addresses both observed problems. I will verify the prior onboarding and activation evidence before committing, while using a guarded test with downstream qualified-revenue and retention checks rather than responding to the competitor with promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run activation messaging because the verified record shows a 6% activation lift, 11% higher week-one engagement, and slightly improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current activation decline with positive downstream evidence. Do not shorten onboarding broadly: although it improves completion, it raises 60-day churn by 9% in complex-workspace accounts. A standard experiment should segment results by workspace complexity and measure activation, qualified revenue, and retention before rollout.
